name: KernelAgentToolRunner

test_list.description: Actual edit, durable question, signed host answer and model continuation share one frame driver.
Deny a later call before any admitted mutation in the same batch executes.
Dropping a waiter signals an owned worker that durably interrupts the request.
A pending human request does not consume every immutable workspace read slot.
Separate runners use the same kernel lease manager and reject the stale second writer.
Missing expected_base is rejected, preserving None as explicit absence.
Reject an insufficient driver result budget before side effects.
Shutdown drains accepted question owners and durable failed tool completions.
Queued writers leave immutable-read admission available.
Cancellation promptly removes a lease waiter.
Reject an unconfigured sandbox profile during admission, before reviews or tool activity.
Separate durable call-bound result evidence from model-visible content.
Preserve the preauthorized command identity through exact diff verification.
Signed host cancellation interrupts only the actual child subtree.
Accept a real mutation, reject substituted unrecorded result evidence and changed source.
Runner cancellation preserves its supplied parent and peer runner.
Opt-in real OpenShell execution; scripted model/count only. Exact reviewed fixed fixture commands, real ordinary/falsifier tests, durable result and current-source completion proof, no leaks.
Opt-in actual pinned llama.cpp model and exact tokenizer through the production prompt assembler, frame driver, authorized kernel tool, verifier and durable journal. Readonly; not full M3.
A bounded ask_user reply exposes its exact real answer CID to the asking runner under Read capability; a peer runner still cannot expand it.
Expiry during a durable human wait must prevent publishing a successful agent tool result while preserving the actual host answer.

Opt-in actual local S2/tokenizer, revision/edit/test tools, exact host execution review, real OpenShell ordinary+falsifier and current-source completion. Semantic S1 assessment is explicitly synthetic, so this is not calibrated hybrid acceptance.

inputs.name: binding
inputs.description: Sealed identity captured from the actual runtime frame.

inputs.name: call
inputs.description: Untrusted model call, fully admitted before any call in the batch executes.

output_description: Real bounded tool results with durable call linkage; execution approval is supplied only by the host.
